article.headline: Stonehill opens the season with an 84-56 win over Curry
article.description: — Jack Medalie had 18 points as Stonehill began its season with an 84-56 win over Curry on Monday.
article.linkText: Stonehill opens the season with an 84-56 win over Curry
article.story: SOUTH EASTON, Mass. -- — Jack Medalie had 18 points as Stonehill began its season with an 84-56 win over Curry on Monday. Medalie added eight rebounds for the Skyhawks. Felipe Patino scored 15 points, going 6 for 10 from the field, including 3 for 7 from 3-point range. Anquan Boldin Jr. had 15 points and shot 5 for 7 from the field, including 2 for 3 from 3-point range, and 3 for 6 from the free-throw line. Isaiah Andino led the way for the Colonels with 15 points. Xavier Daniel added 11 points and three steals for Curry. Shaqkobi Kerr also had seven points and two steals. Up next Stonehill visits Fordham on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
